title: Pink Punk Gig Flyer
coreRelationships: Bold, dark typography contrasts sharply with the light pink background.
Varying font styles and sizes create a dynamic and somewhat disorganized visual flow.
The large band names 'SD' and 'TUFFNUTZ' dominate the central area of the flyer.
Smaller, handwritten text provides additional event details and a concluding message.
The abstract hand illustration at the top serves as an introductory visual element.
reuseFormula: Create a hand-drawn, black-on-pink flyer. Use a vibrant pink background. Render all text and illustrations in black ink with a raw, imperfect, hand-drawn quality. Feature two to three main band names in large, bold, distressed, and/or shadowed block lettering, centrally placed. Include a smaller, abstract illustration at the top. Add event details (venue, date, price, age restriction) in varying handwritten or slightly less prominent block fonts. Conclude with a small, quirky, handwritten message at the bottom. Ensure high contrast and a dense, energetic composition typical of punk rock flyers.
